triangle_two_path7.lower_order_proof: A Steiner tree with at most8 edges connecting three marked vertices has two marked-to-marked paths of length at most7 whose interiors contain no other marked vertex.

order16_local_obstruction.scope: An actual acute Coxeter chamber and actual3-finite/1-ideal quadrilateral in H16, with complete cone census and strict escape. It obstructs a local payment rule, not a theorem restricted to finite-volume chambers.
